name: nft-two-drops-first-unrelated
description: unrelated drop precedes the peer drop; the later rule still decides
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.9.9.9 drop

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
